questions.prompt: Is there a defect in how this code splits a visit charge between patient and payer? If so, mark the line(s) where it is; otherwise answer that there is none.
billVisit is called twice for the same appointment after a worker retry. What prevents a double charge?
choices: The idempotency key visit-charge:<appointmentId> passed to the store
The zero-sum balance check in Ledger.post
Nothing; the patient is billed twice

questions.prompt: Why does Ledger.post reject amounts that are not integers?
choices: Integer cents avoid binary floating-point representation errors that would make balances drift
Because JavaScript numbers cannot hold negative fractions
Because the store column is a string

questions.prompt: For a self-pay visit (payerId null) with allowedAmountCents 15000 and copayCents 2000, what does the patient receivable increase by?
choices: 0, since self-pay is collected up front
